gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Ceptics CTU-9C it recommended at $17.99 costs $9.99 on Ceptics' own store today (2026-11-09). $17.99 is the price of the CTU-9-9C two-pack, which adds a grounded Type E/F (Schuko) plug.
standout_why: I compared four rival pages. packandporter.com prices the Ceptics 11-piece kit at $27.99 and the EPICKA TA-105C at $17.99, but not the CTU-9C or TESSAN. nbcnews.com (NBC Select) prices the Epicka Pulse 45W at $34.99 at Epicka and Amazon items only. wpa-pool.com and thefinerroute.com state no prices at all. None of them prices ChatGPT's two picks from the maker's store, and none shows that TESSAN sells a cheaper 65 W universal adapter (WTA09, $27.99) next to the WTA07 ($42.99). None says the TESSAN TC03 converter tops out at 250 W, which is too little for a hair dryer.
decides: Confirms a Type C adapter as the pick for a continental-only trip and cuts its price nearly in half: CTU-9C at $9.99, or $17.99 for the two-pack with Schuko. For a trip that includes the UK, a universal 65 W adapter is the pick, and TESSAN's WTA09 ($27.99) beats our listed WTA07 ($42.99) on price at the same 65 W top port. Shoppers who need to run a hair dryer should skip the TC03 (250 W cap) and buy TESSAN's 2000 W converter combo ($45.99).
